title: Oscar and the Hollow
author: Vesper Ravensworth
blurb: Zephyrine Voss, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
